decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD costs almost nothing to keep listed in a warehouse-backed catalog of 60,000 items, and one year of results reveals too little to justify abandoning an option that supports the firm's genre-broadening strategy.

The illustrated release series builds directly on the label's core reissue competence, has several models whose value is still unfolding, and is cheap to keep open, so management keeps the option alive while uncertainty resolves.
